scope: Training and model-selection snapshot and one matched calibration probe; not final mission validation

orbital-hold.interpretation: Complete training only; hold qualities are recorded endpoint summaries, not independently reconstructed for every flight. No full mission or stable insertion was achieved.

vertical-selection.purpose: Model selection; not final unseen checkpoint validation

vertical-robust.purpose: Model selection; not final unseen checkpoint validation

attitude-g2-selection.purpose: Model selection; not final unseen checkpoint validation

attitude-adaptive-g6-selection.purpose: Model selection; not final unseen checkpoint validation

groundThrottleJointSelectionPlan.scope: Frozen selection plan and decoded-weight verification; the completed comparison is reported separately.

plan.purpose: Evaluate the learned all-ground throttle settings with the released gimbal controller on complete flights before considering promotion. The isolated training branch is a diagnostic reference, not a fallback release candidate.
plan.selectionRule: Only the joint candidate is eligible for later final testing. Require strictly more normal landings than the released controller across all 96 matched cases, no lower normal landing count on the original four or the released ten mission subsets, and more normal than covered landings. Keep every failure. No coefficient adjustment or model switch based on this selection set. A passing selection requires a separately frozen, unseen final comparison with the release and sensory controls before deployment.
plan.fixedProtocol: Full original flights to actual landing/failure/deadline, exact native full-graph decisions, gain 1, automatic odor off, style reward off, full original physical criteria, two nominal and two varied cases per mission. No state oracle, teacher, warm-up or truncated endpoint.

groundThrottleJointSelection.scope: Complete matched development selection; not final unseen validation. The isolated throttle branch is a diagnostic reference only.

groundJointFocusedTrainingPlan.scope: Verified frozen training plan; plan existence does not establish live job status, and partial outcomes are not qualification evidence.

plan.purpose: Jointly learn throttle, attitude and gimbal control from intact released G5 on five poorly performing ground missions while retaining the four original anchors.
plan.trainingSeedScope: Existing deterministic training case rule retained; prior training cases may recur. None of the rejected fresh selection seeds is reused. Search proposal seed is new.
plan.fixedProtocol: Complete original endpoints; full graph twice each decision; no input, hidden-state actor, decoder layout, physics, deadline or success-threshold changes; style off, gain1, auto-odor off.
plan.selection: Training only. Freeze completed generation6 candidate before fresh all24 selection with releasedG5 and matched sensory controls. No coefficient transplant or deployment from training; independent unseen JavaScript final tests required after passing selection.

gimbalGenerationTwoSelection.scope: Compare the frozen generation-two gimbal controller with the released controller on matched fresh starts, plus covered eyes and a gimbal-only ablation. This is model selection, not final validation.
gimbalGenerationTwoSelection.promotionRule: Candidate must land at least as many total flights and original-four-mission flights as the released baseline, with nonzero learned gimbal commands. Retain all ablation outcomes. Any promoted candidate still requires separate frozen final JavaScript tests.

additionalGroundScout.scope: Development survey of the 14 additional ground missions using the frozen released generation-six controller; one nominal and one varied start per mission, not a reliability test.

orbitalCalibration.scope: Held-out calibration contexts selected regularization; trajectory probes are development checks, not final mission validation.

gimbalGenerationFiveSelection.scope: Complete generation-five development selection; released baseline and 40-start cohort reused from the earlier candidate comparison. Not final validation.

highReturnProbe.scope: One complete development probe of the released controller; original full-flight outcome exactly reproduced by replaying every recorded action.

gimbalGenerationFiveProbe.purpose: Complete development-trajectory replay. Quality duration is sampled at decision endpoints; the insertion hold is measured at every original physics step. No mission criterion or controller action is changed.

orbitalCalibratedInitialReplay.purpose: Complete development-trajectory replay. Quality duration is sampled at decision endpoints; the insertion hold is measured at every original physics step. No mission criterion or controller action is changed.

orbitalCalibratedGenerationSixReplay.purpose: Complete development-trajectory replay. Quality duration is sampled at decision endpoints; the insertion hold is measured at every original physics step. No mission criterion or controller action is changed.

orbitalHoldGenerationSixReplay.scope: Six complete diagnostic probes of the final sustained-insertion candidate, with exact action replay; not independent qualification or reliability testing.

plan.purpose: Complete trajectory diagnosis of the frozen final sustained-insertion candidate after432 failed full training trips. Record commands and presented/decoded signals; reconstruct actual trajectory via exact physical replay. Diagnostic only, not independent reliability or release testing.
plan.selection: No parameter selection from these diagnostic cases. Preserve all original physical endpoints and all failed trips; no gain/style/odor interventions.

replay.purpose: Complete development-trajectory replay. Quality duration is sampled at decision endpoints; the insertion hold is measured at every original physics step. No mission criterion or controller action is changed.

insertionHoldReward.scope: Outcome-only reward qualification and the frozen plan for completed training; no new orbital capability or final reliability claim.

completeFlightParity.scope: Two complete deterministic parity checks, not new reliability tests. Compare the same frozen weights, cases and native build before and after outcome-only reward instrumentation.

plan.purpose: Learn sustained proximity to the original three-second orbital insertion conditions after complete trajectory evidence of transient high scores and subsequent escape. No reward measurements enter controller inputs or actions.
plan.reward: After each original physics step, exp(-(max(0,800-periapsis)/200 + max(0,abs(apoapsis-destination)-200)/200 + max(0,abs(radialSpeed)-5)/5)), with zero for non-finite distance. Keep the maximum time-weighted mean over the trailing three seconds, padding early windows with zero. Orbital fitness uses 0.1*originalScore + 1200*holdQuality + 200*min(1,maxAltitude/destination). Preserve original instantaneous insertion metrics separately.
plan.physicalCompletion: Unchanged original launch, stable insertion, full revolution, deorbit, entry and safe barge touchdown. Every trip continues to its original endpoint. No reward value completes a milestone.
plan.selection: Training only. Freeze a candidate before a new independent validation plan. Preserve every failed flight and do not infer full mission success from the shaped score.

launchParameters.note: The launch command explicitly retained SUITE_TOUCHDOWN_MARGIN=3. This existing successful-touchdown penalty was omitted from the prose formula in the pre-launch plan; the original plan is preserved. For landed trips, fitness additionally subtracts 3*(vertical touchdown speed squared + lateral touchdown speed squared). Landing count and milestone ordering remain first.
